categories.name: Ball Handling
categories.description: Improve your dribble confidence and control

drills.name: Stationary Crossover
drills.description: Low, fast crossovers in place. Keep eyes up.

drills.name: Two Ball Dribble
drills.description: Both balls simultaneously, then alternating.

drills.name: Figure 8
drills.description: Weave ball through legs in figure 8 pattern.

drills.name: Spider Dribble
drills.description: 4-tap pattern: front-front-back-back. Fast hands.

drills.name: Pound Dribble
drills.description: Hard dribble as low as possible, each hand.

drills.name: Hesitation (Hesi) Drill
drills.description: Walk up, freeze with eye fake, explode past.

drills.name: Behind the Back
drills.description: Stationary behind-the-back crossovers.

drills.name: Between the Legs
drills.description: Alternating between-the-leg dribbles moving forward.

categories.name: Shooting
categories.description: Track makes and percentages to see real improvement

drills.name: Free Throws
drills.description: Shoot from the charity stripe. Focus on routine.

drills.name: Corner 3s
drills.description: Both corners. Catch and shoot, game-speed setup.

drills.name: Wing 3s
drills.description: Left and right wing. Focus on balance and follow-through.

drills.name: Top of Key 3s
drills.description: Straight on 3s. Repeat shot until rhythm is locked in.

drills.name: Mid-Range Jumper
drills.description: Elbow jumpers and baseline mid-range. Bread and butter.

drills.name: Pull-Up Jumper
drills.description: Off dribble. Simulate game situations.

drills.name: Floater / Runner
drills.description: Off two feet and one foot. Kiss it off the glass.

drills.name: Mikan Drill
drills.description: Alternating layups under the basket, no dribble.

drills.name: Form Shooting (Close Range)
drills.description: 1-2 ft from basket. Perfect mechanics, one hand.

categories.name: Footwork
categories.description: The foundation of elite basketball movement

drills.name: Defensive Slides
drills.description: Side-to-side defensive position slides. Stay low.

drills.name: Drop Step Finish
drills.description: Post up, drop step, power layup. Both sides.

drills.name: Jab Step Series
drills.description: Jab and shoot, jab and drive, jab and crossover.

drills.name: V-Cut to Catch
drills.description: Cut hard toward basket, plant, explode back to catch.

drills.name: Pivot & Protect
drills.description: Catch, pivot away from pressure, read defense.

drills.name: Box Out Technique
drills.description: Stance, contact, hold ground for 3 seconds.

drills.name: Closeout Drill
drills.description: Sprint from paint, chop steps at shooter, no foul.

categories.name: Conditioning
categories.description: Build the engine to play your game in the 4th quarter

drills.name: Suicides (Full Court)
drills.description: Touch baseline, FT line, half court, far FT, far baseline.

drills.name: 17s
drills.description: Baseline to baseline 17 times in 60 seconds.

drills.name: Line Drills
drills.description: Sprint baseline → FT → baseline → half → baseline → far FT → baseline.

drills.name: Full Court Layups
drills.description: Dribble full court each direction, no stopping.

drills.name: Jump Rope
drills.description: Single bounce, alternating feet, double-unders.

drills.name: Defensive Shell Drill
drills.description: Contain the ball handler for full possession.

categories.name: Explosiveness
categories.description: Add inches to your vert and first-step quickness

drills.name: Box Jumps
drills.description: Explode onto box, step down controlled. Full extension.

drills.name: Depth Jumps
drills.description: Step off box, land and immediately jump as high as possible.

drills.name: Broad Jumps
drills.description: Max horizontal jump distance. Stick the landing.

drills.name: Single Leg Hops
drills.description: Hop forward on one leg, absorb landing, repeat.

drills.name: Approach Jump (Max Vert)
drills.description: 2-3 step approach, two-foot takeoff. Touch highest point.

drills.name: Lateral Cone Hops
drills.description: Quick side-to-side hops over cone. Fast feet.

drills.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
drills.description: Rear foot elevated, drive through front heel.

categories.name: Skill Work
categories.description: IQ, passing, finishing — the details that win games

drills.name: Wall Passing
drills.description: Chest pass, bounce pass, overhead. Off wall at game speed.

drills.name: Euro Step Finish
drills.description: Gather, step left, step right (or reverse). Soft finish.

drills.name: Reverse Layup
drills.description: Attack baseline, reverse finish off glass. Both hands.

drills.name: Post Move Sequence
drills.description: Catch in post, up-fake, drop step, hook. Both sides.

drills.name: Spin Move to Layup
drills.description: Drive baseline, spin, protect ball, finish strong.

drills.name: Shot Fake & Drive
drills.description: Catch, shot fake, one dribble pull-up or drive to basket.
